title: 7. Internal Game Concept One Sheet
use_cases: Use when pitching a new game idea to internal stakeholders or executive leadership
Implement when defining the core narrative and conflict during pre-production
Configure when establishing game pillars and tone for the development team
Use when alignning the character design team with story requirements
content:
This is a sheet to show your fellow developers and higher-ups. It’s essentially a pitch to ensure everyone is on the same page (har har) and approves the concept. What we include:

Narrative Hook

The Fantasy

Core Conflict

- Who wants what from whom?

Main Character (Player Character)

- Who is our main character? What do they want? What do they need? What are their attributes, powers, and/or skills? Flaws?

Antagonist

- Who is our main baddie? What do they want (and how is it at odds with our main character’s wants)? What powers and skills do they have?

The World What sort of world do our characters inhabit?

Why Now? Why is this conflict happening now? What is the urgency? Why must the player character act now?

Pillars

Tone
